description: SIRAC - flux trafic en temps réel is a dataset listed in Plateforme Open Data Ville et Eurométropole de Strasbourg, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Ville et eurométropole de Strasbourg. Ce jeu de données contient les arcs de trafic du réseau routier de l'Eurométropole fournis par le SIRAC. Les données sont mises à jour automatiquement 24h/24, 7j/7 toutes les 3 minutes à partir de l'url. Les informations de trafic ne concernent pas le réseau non géré par le SIRAC. Coverage: Strasbourg Eurométropole. The portal files it under Mobilité, Transports. Its keywords are trafic, temps réel, Strasbourg, sirac, trafic vélo, infotrafic. The portal shows 468 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-strasbourg-eu-portal.
